title: Feature Module Structure
prompt:
Co-locate a feature's component, hook, and types in a single folder. Compose them in a public `index.ts` so the rest of the app imports `from './todos'`. **Requirements:** 1. In `todos/types.ts`, export `type Todo = { id: number; title: string; done: boolean };`. 2. In `todos/useTodos.ts`, import `useState` from `react` and `Todo` from `./types`. Export `function useTodos()` that returns `{ todos: Todo[]; add: (t: Todo) => void }` (with a `useState([])` and `add = (t) => setTodos([...todos, t])`). 3. In `todos/TodoList.tsx`, import `useTodos` from `./useTodos`. Export `function TodoList()` that renders the list of todos as `
  • {title}
` and a ``. 4. In `todos/index.ts`, re-export `TodoList`, `useTodos`, and `Todo` (the public API).

files.content: export type Todo = { id: number; title: string; done: boolean };

hints: Co-location turns a feature into a self-contained unit -- you can move it between projects.
Public surface lives in `index.ts`; internal files can be reorganized without breaking imports outside the folder.
Inside the feature, use relative paths (`./types`); outside, use the feature's barrel (`from '@/features/todos'`).
